title: Add comprehensive AI agent design for automated enterprise app development
body:
Delivers complete technical documentation for an AI agent system that generates enterprise management applications from natural language requirements using @objectstack/spec protocols.

## Documentation Structure (5 files, 128KB, 4.6k lines)

### 1. Metadata Protocol Reference (`业务开发元数据清单.md`)
- Cataloged 108+ protocols across 9 categories (ObjectQL, ObjectUI, Automation, Auth, API, AI, System, Integration, Hub)
- Priority classification (P0/P1/P2/P3) with business scenarios
- Code templates for CRM, ERP, project management domains

### 2. System Architecture (`AI-AGENT-设计方案.md`)
- **4-layer architecture**: Agent orchestration → LLM routing → Knowledge/data → ObjectStack runtime
- **6 core agents**: Requirement understanding, Architecture design, Metadata generation, Code generation, Testing validation, Optimization iteration
- **RAG architecture**: Hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword), Cohere rerank, context enrichment
- **Multi-model routing**: Task-based routing (GPT-4o/Claude 3.5/Llama 3), cost optimization (50%+ savings)
- **4-layer validation**: Zod schema → Business rules → Best practices → Performance checks

### 3. Implementation Roadmap (`AI-AGENT-开发计划.md`)
- 12-week plan across 5 phases (Prep → Infrastructure → Core agents → Code gen → Optimization)
- 60+ granular tasks with ownership assignments
- Team structure: 9 engineers (1 tech lead, 2 AI, 2 backend, 2 frontend, 1 QA, 1 DevOps)
- Budget: $4,122 infrastructure costs (OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, Pinecone, AWS RDS/EC2)
- Risk mitigation for LLM hallucination, cost overrun, performance bottlenecks

### 4. Documentation Index (`AI-AGENT-README.md`)
- Quick navigation by role (product/technical/decision-maker)
- Success metrics: 10-42x dev efficiency gain, 80%+ test coverage, 90% cost reduction
- End-to-end CRM example: 8.5 min from requirements to runnable app

## Key Technical Decisions

**Metadata Validation Pipeline**:
```typescript
// Layer 1: Type safety via Zod
ServiceObjectSchema.parse(object);

// Layer 2: Business rules
if (Object.keys(object.fields).length < 1) error("Missing fields");

// Layer 3: Naming conventions
if (!object.name.match(/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/)) warn("Use snake_case");

// Layer 4: Performance optimization
if (lookupFields.length > 0) suggest("Add indexes on: " + lookupFields);
```

**Model Routing Strategy**:
- Architecture/reasoning tasks → GPT-4o (quality)
- Code generation patterns → GPT-3.5-turbo (cost)
- Long context (100k+ tokens) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet
- Privacy/offline → Local Llama 3

**RAG Retrieval Flow**:
1. Vector search (semantic, top-20)
2. Keyword search (exact, top-10)
3. Hybrid combine + Cohere rerank
4. Filter threshold > 0.75, return top-5

## Expected Outcomes

| Metric | Traditional | AI Agent | Improvement |
|--------|------------|----------|-------------|
| CRM dev time | 2-3 weeks | 2-4 hours | **42x** |
| Test coverage | 50-70% | 80%+ | +30% |
| Cost per project | $20k | $2k | **90%** |

**Target**: Generate TypeScript apps with 80%+ test coverage, 100% type safety, validated against @objectstack/spec schemas in <10 minutes.
